title: Reach Router
description: An accessible, small-footprint router for React by Ryan Florence.

data.text: Reach Router is a small, accessible routing library for React created by Ryan Florence. It focuses on accessibility by managing focus and providing screen-reader-friendly navigation, making it a great choice for inclusive applications.

data.title: Declarative Routing
data.content: Use Reach Router's declarative API with Router and Route components.

data.title: Reach Router and React Router
data.text: Reach Router was merged into React Router v6. Its focus management and accessibility features are now part of React Router.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Focus management built in for screen readers
Now part of React Router v6 ecosystem
data.takeaway: Reach Router set the standard for accessible routing in React applications.
